text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"DM-002","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D15","page":1,"quote":"30"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D23","page":1,"quote":"30"}],"comment":"Dimensions D15 and D23 both give the value 30 for the same feature in the same view, over-dimensioning the part. The designer should remove one of these duplicate dimensions.","recommended_correction":"Delete either D15 or D23 so the size is dimensioned only once."},{"rule_id":"MX-006","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D5","page":1,"quote":"2-⌀15"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D9","page":1,"quote":"2-⌀8.4"}],"comment":"The patterns of two ⌀15 holes (D5) and two ⌀8.4 holes (D9) have no PCD, spacing, pitch, coordinates, or linear locating dimensions anywhere in the drawing. Without positional information the machinist cannot locate these hole patterns on the part. The designer must add dimensions that fully define the position of each pattern.","recommended_correction":"Add a PCD, center-to-center spacing, or linear locating dimensions for the 2-⌀15 and 2-⌀8.4 hole patterns."},{"rule_id":"MD-002","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D21","page":1,"quote":"20±0.02"}],"comment":"The drawing carries a tolerance of ±0.02 (D21) and an H7 fit code (D24) but has no datum flags or GD&T frames at all. Without datums there is no defined reference frame to inspect or machine these tight tolerances consistently. The designer must establish a datum reference frame appropriate to the functional features.","recommended_correction":"Add datum feature symbols and reference them in the applicable GD&T frames or tolerance call-outs."}]}
